contact_privacy.title: Contact Privacy Settings
contact_privacy.description: Set your privacy preferences for contact requests, DMs, and online status

handle_searchable.label: Allow search by @handle
handle_searchable.help: People who know your @handle can find you in search

contact_approval.label: Require approval for contact requests
contact_approval.help: If OFF, people are added instantly without a request (recommended: ON)

online_section.label: Who can see your online status
online_section.help: Choose who can see your last-seen time and current online status

guide.page_title: How to use Contact Privacy Settings
guide.description: Here you can control who can find you, who can DM you, and who can see your online status, all in one place. If this is your first time, just go from top to bottom. When in doubt, leave the recommended settings (approval ON, narrow visibility) as they are.

search.title: Allow search by @handle
search.body: This controls whether people who know your @handle (username) can find you in search. When OFF, you will not appear in search results even if someone knows your @handle.

steps.step2: Turn it ON if you want to be found, or OFF if you don't want to be searched

approval.title: Approval for contact requests
approval.body: This controls whether your approval is required when someone tries to add you as a contact. When ON, you first receive a request and only the people you approve become contacts (recommended). When OFF, people are added directly without any request.

steps.step1: Find the "Require approval for contact requests" switch
steps.step2: Keep it ON (recommended) so strangers can't add you without permission, then save

dm.title: Who can send you DMs
dm.body: Choose who can send you direct messages (DMs). Pick one of the three options.
dm.options_intro: There are three options to choose from.
dm.anyone: Anyone — anyone in the app can DM you
dm.team_members_only: Team members only — only people on your team can DM you
dm.contacts_only: Contacts only — only people in your contacts can DM you (the narrowest option)

online.title: Who can see your online status
online.body: Choose who can see whether you are online now and when you were last online. Select "Nobody" if you don't want to be seen.
online.nobody: Nobody — your online status is never shown
online.contacts_only: Contacts only — only people in your contacts can see it
online.everyone: Everyone — everyone in the app can see it

save.title: Saving your settings
save.body: Whenever you change a setting, be sure to save at the end. Changes are not applied until you save.

steps.step1: Configure the options above as you like
steps.step2: Press the "Save" button at the bottom of the page
